items.t: Ecopetrol's "New Era": The Company Announces Pricing of US$2.0 Billion in International Bonds to Optimize Its Debt Profile
items.sum: Ecopetrol S.A. (BVC: ECOPETROL; NYSE: EC) announces that, it has successfully priced an SEC-registered offering of US$2.0 billion 7.875% Notes due 2034 (the "Notes") with strong demand received from both domestic and international investors which reinforces market confidence in Ecopetrol's renewal and strategic transformation. Ecopetrol S.A. Reports 12.8% Sales Increase and 60% Net Profit Growth for First Six Months of 2026
Ecopetrol Revises Timing for the Release of Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Earnings Conference Call
items.sum: Ecopetrol S.A. (BVC: ECOPETROL; NYSE: EC) (the "Company") announces that it has revised the date on which it will release its financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026. Accordingly, the results will be announced on Thursday, November 12, 2026, after market close.

Ecopetrols 'New Era' Announces Appointment of Corporate Vice President of Organizational Talent
items.sum: Ecopetrol S.A. (BVC: ECOPETROL; NYSE: EC) ("Ecopetrol" or the "Company") announces that its Board of Directors has appointed Gladys Vega Valencia as Corporate Vice President of Organizational Talent. Ms. Vega is expected to assume the position no later than November 17, 2026.
